fix(camellia): show device properties inline

Summary:
- Move the device list height budget to the whole left card so the header no longer adds extra page height.
- Remove the vertical scroll wrapper from the right property table so every property row renders inline.

Rationale:
- DAM-90 requires the left pane to be the fixed-height scroller while the right pane follows its content.
- The prior property-table scroller conflicted with the explicit requirement to show all right-side properties.

Tests:
- just camellia check
- pnpm --filter @theaceae/camellia build
- git diff --check
